About

Bold ideas,
built for the feed.

I'm a junior graphic designer working across FMCG, food, beauty and service brands — mostly for Arabic-speaking social feeds. My job is to make a thumb stop scrolling: a dinosaur out of a coffee cup, a dragon behind a chip bag, a bottle wrapped in a ribbon of water.

I build every piece from rough concept to final export in Photoshop, Canva and Figma — and I'm always chasing the next idea worth stopping for.

§

Concept First

Every piece starts with one bold idea — a burst, a dragon, a sprint — before a single asset is opened.

×

Bilingual by Default

Arabic and Latin type share the same frame constantly, so both need to look intentional — never translated.

~

Built for the Feed

Square, vertical, high-contrast — every file is shaped for the exact scroll it has to stop.
